lines.text: Many learners say: I am angry to my brother.
Better: I am angry with my brother.
With! She is angry with me.

data.wrong: I am angry to my brother.
data.right: I am angry with my brother.
data.memory: I am angry with my brother.

native.tip: Türkçede “kardeşime kızgınım” deriz; İngilizcede “angry” sözcüğünden sonra “with” gelir: “I am angry with my brother.”
native.caption: “I am angry to my brother” mi diyorsun? 😅 “Angry” sözcüğünden sonra “to” değil, “with” gelir. Doğrusu “I am angry with my brother.” Carlos’u dinle ve tekrar et! Lexkite uygulamasını aç, daha çok pratik yap.
native.comment: Cevap: “with”. Kızgın olduğun kişiden önce “with” kullan. Şimdi kendi cümleni yaz ve sesli söyle: {link}

en.tip: Use “with” after “angry”: “I am angry with my brother.”
en.caption: Do you say “I am angry to my brother”? 😅 In English we say angry with a person, not angry to. The right sentence is “I am angry with my brother.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Open the Lexkite app and practice more.
